steps.name: account_id
steps.note: Comes from authenticated session, never asked of customer.

steps.name: verify_identity
steps.note: System looks up the account using session-derived account_id.

steps.name: order_id
steps.note: If customer has exactly one open order, system_derivable instead -- try lookup before asking.

steps.name: get_shipping_status
steps.note: System call, not a customer question -- ABCD's 'ask shipping status' step is wrong to ask; it's account data.

steps.name: membership_level
steps.note: ABCD's guideline says 'ask the customer' -- this should be looked up from the account, not asked.

steps.name: validate_purchase
steps.note: System check: was this a real purchase, within window.

steps.name: refund_reason
steps.note: Extracted from customer message, constrained to a fixed enum (stain/color/size/defect).

steps.name: refund_amount
steps.note: Pulled from order line-item price, NOT asked of or trusted from the customer -- money value.

steps.name: queue_refund_for_approval
steps.note: Per current scope: all refunds route to human approval, not auto-executed.
